objective: Prevent chat/runtime stagnation caused by excessive external calls, polling loops, repeated recovery, or opening work too close to the turn budget.

durable_checkpoint.rule: Persist receipt/checkpoint before any further external interaction when expensive work was opened.

invariants: Never exceed 15 external calls in one execution block.
Batch independent reads/writes when the connector supports it.
At most one expensive unit may be open without a durable receipt.
A transport timeout is not a worker failure; exactly-once heavy supervisor remains mandatory.
No blind retry: recover PID/receipt/checkpoint first.
If the objective cannot close within the remaining budget, freeze a reanudable checkpoint instead of polling.
Calls 12-15 are a safety reserve and cannot increase scientific scope.
